pipeline.testNotes: Gates run in workspace (HEAD cc9a3a6a5f): npm run typecheck (pass, incl. dashboard-types guard), npm run lint (pass, exit 0), npm test (full suite: 1015 files/9374 tests passed, 3/50 skipped) and cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run src/components/CommandDeck/__tests__/ProjectOverview.test.tsx (24/24 passed). Matches Cloister's own verification-latest.json (typecheck/frontend-typecheck/lint/build/server-bundle/test all passed at lastVerifiedCommit=cc9a3a6a5f). Diff of PipelineRow.tsx verified line-by-line against vBRIEF item widen-title-grid: gridTemplateColumns is exactly '78px 1fr 74px 34px' with the old 200px status column removed (ac1); title stays a full-width truncating span (ac2); metadata line is one flex row (mt-[3px] flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 overflow-hidden) holding the shrink-0 status chip plus a single truncate span rendering [sublineFor(entry), whoLineFor(entry)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') (ac3); .filter(Boolean) guards the null whoLineFor case so no dangling separator, cost/session column and avatar column untouched (ac4). UAT: built and ran the dashboard from this workspace (docker compose stack overdeck-feature-pan-2532-{frontend,server,dev}, Vite HMR on the bind-mounted workspace source) at https://feature-pan-2532.overdeck.localhost, confirmed by traefik router API since the checked-in docker-compose.devcontainer.yml host-rule comments are stale. Found and fixed an unrelated container-hygiene gap (container's shared node_modules volume was missing posthog-js, added to package.json in a prior commit already on this branch, before this container's last install) via bun install + frontend container restart -- this only touched the throwaway workspace container, not code/config/tests. App then loaded cleanly with no PAN-2532-related console errors. Could not populate a live PipelineRow with real long-title data in this isolated container: it starts with zero registered projects/agents by design (no Deacon, no host state mount), and adding a project hit a pre-existing, unrelated origin-mismatch bug in this workspace's docker-compose.devcontainer.yml (OVERDECK_TRUSTED_ORIGINS/labels still say feature-pan-2532.pan.localhost while traefik's live rule is feature-pan-2532.overdeck.localhost, so authenticated API calls 401/403) -- fixing that requires editing configuration, which is outside this test role's boundaries and unrelated to the PAN-2532 diff. No acceptance criteria, issue body, or vBRIEF verify_commands call for browser UAT; the vBRIEF's own required checks (typecheck, lint, ProjectOverview.test.tsx) are exactly what ran and passed. Verdict: PASSED on gate results plus verified spec-conformant diff; recommend filing the docker-compose origin-mismatch as a separate follow-up issue since it will block future UAT-required workspace tests.
